summary: All four files reviewed against maintainability, correctness, SQL quality, and established project patterns. No blocking issues. No Fix-Forward changes needed. comments.note: m041_add_original_filename.sql: the manual rollback procedure comment is excellent practice. Matches the style of existing migrations and gives ops a clear recovery path if forward migration needs to be reversed.

GetOriginalFilenameAsync SQL is defensively written: LEFT JOIN correctly handles the zero-filenames edge case (returns NULL cleanly instead of no rows). COALESCE logic covers all three cases: (1) original_filename set — returns it regardless of filenames; (2) original_filename NULL, filenames present — returns earliest; (3) original_filename NULL, no filenames — returns NULL. All correct.
